lifecycle.reason: Read from the mandated Drupal core @deprecated annotation form.
lifecycle.source_annotation: in drupal:8.2.0 and is removed from drupal:10.0.0. Use $this->assertSession()->responseContains() for non-HTML responses, like XML or Json. $this->assertSession()->pageTextContains() for HTML responses. Unlike the deprecated assertText(), the passed text should be HTML decoded, exactly as a human sees it in the browser.

replacement.semantics: A replacement is recorded only when the annotation states one. An equivalent API is never inferred.
